verdict.rationale: RudderStack documents building audiences (from warehouse or event sources) and activating them to downstream tools (rudderstack-docs-6, -27, -38), plus real-time/near-real-time event visibility (rudderstack-docs-10, -43), which supports continuous sync infrastructure. However, there is no explicit documentation of incremental/near-real-time membership updates (entry/exit) for audience sync specifically to ad platforms, nor evidence of sync frequency or refresh cadence for reverse-ETL audience activation. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of audience sync scheduling/frequency, confirmation of near-real-time membership add/remove semantics, and independent/hands-on validation of continuous audience activation to ad platforms.
